| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Wavelength** `wavelength` | 8 | 2 to 64 px | The distance from one stripe of the wave to the next. |
| **Angle** `angle` | 0 | 0 to 180 deg | The direction in which the wave changes. 0 changes along x and finds vertical stripes. Angles turn counterclockwise. |
| **Sigma** `sigma` | 4 | 0.5 to 20 px | The size of the Gaussian window along the wave. The window ends at 3 sigma. |
| **Aspect ratio** `aspect` | 1 | 0.2 to 5 | Sigma along the wave divided by sigma along the stripes. Below 1 the window is long along the stripes. |
| **Output** `output` | Magnitude | Magnitude, Real part (cosine), Imaginary part (sine) | Which part of the complex response to show. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Stretch to full range | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
